li.label: shared the shade
li.description: It was too hot for anything to be afraid of anything. A wild animal and I shared the only shade there was until the sun moved.

li.label: a trick for the dry country
li.description: A traveler showed me how their people manage out in the sand and the sun. It's simpler than what I was doing.

li.label: a cold night under the stars
li.description: The desert goes cold after dark, and the sky fills up with stars. I watched an animal drink by their light.

li.label: followed tracks in the snow
li.description: I followed a line of tracks across the snow until I found who made them. Worth the cold feet.

li.label: a still, frozen morning
li.description: Everything was white and silent this morning, and the only thing moving was an animal's breath on the air.

li.label: a trick against the cold
li.description: How to keep the frost off, from a traveler who's known worse cold than this. I'm trying it tonight.

li.label: eyes in the green
li.description: I looked up from the path and something was watching me from the undergrowth, close enough to touch. Then it wasn't.

li.label: something in the undergrowth
li.description: An animal kept pace with me through the green all the way back from the far plot. I never once saw it properly.

li.label: a cape of leaves
li.description: Four broad leaves and a few thorns, and the traveler had made me a rain cape. It keeps the wet off better than my coat.

li.label: something in the reeds
li.description: I was up to my knees in black water when an animal went past me through the reeds without a sound. I held my breath until it was gone.

li.label: lights over the marsh
li.description: Pale lights drifted over the marsh last night. My animal watched them with me. I don't know what they were.

li.label: lights over the marsh
li.description: Lights moved out over the marsh last night where nobody could be standing. My animal growled at them. I haven't stopped thinking about it.

li.label: an animal on the ridge
li.description: An animal stood on the ridge above me against the sky, perfectly still, and then stepped over the top and was gone.

li.label: news of the high roads
li.description: The traveler came over the high pass and told me about the cold at the top, the kind that gets into your teeth. I'd like to see it anyway.

li.label: my animal found a cave
li.description: My animal found a crack in the rock with cold air coming out of it, and came back to fetch me. We stood at the mouth and listened.

li.label: the tide line
li.description: I walked the shore at low tide and had company: an animal working along the wrack ahead of me, picking through what the sea left.

li.label: a shell from the trader
li.description: The trader pressed a shell into my hand and wouldn't take anything for it. It's on my windowsill now.

li.label: watched the sea in bad weather
li.description: My animal and I sat on the rocks and watched the waves come in gray and huge. Neither of us wanted to go in.

li.label: the first green
li.description: An animal found the first green shoots of the year before we did. Its ribs still showed from the winter.

li.label: getting ready for winter
li.description: A small animal was carrying food to its hole while I carried sacks to the storeroom. We kept at it all afternoon.

li.label: cooled off in the water
li.description: It was so hot that my animal and I walked straight into the water and stood there. Best part of the day.

li.label: a hot drink for a cold traveler
li.description: A traveler came in from the cold blue to the lips, and I put a hot cup in their hands. I watched the color come back.

li.label: waited out the rain together
li.description: The rain came down in sheets, and my animal leaned against my legs, steaming, until it stopped.

li.label: a shape in the fog
li.description: A big dark shape came out of the fog at me and turned into an animal. We both stopped dead, then both backed off.

li.label: frightened in the fog
li.description: Something big came at me out of the fog. It was only an animal. My heart didn't slow down for ages.

li.label: snow and an animal
li.description: An animal went mad in the snow this morning, leaping and rolling and biting at the flakes. I laughed until I was cold.

li.label: calmed my animal in the storm
li.description: The thunder frightened my animal half to death. I sat on the floor with it and talked until it stopped shaking.

li.label: other names for the stars
li.description: Their people have their own names for the stars, and a story for each. The traveler went across the whole sky with me.

li.label: late talk at the caravan
li.description: I sat up with the trader long after the trading was done, talking about the road and the people we'd left behind.
